topic: Overseer behavioral fixes — structural enforcement over behavioral rules
insight: Replace behavioral rules with structural constraints. 6 Core Principles (CP1-CP6) with typed field enums, Dispatch Acceptance Gate (5 checks) embedded in all 9 agent definitions, positive framing mandate. Key insight: structural enforcement beats behavioral rules because typed enums physically prevent undesired content. Protocol-embedded validation (co-located with fields) is superior to script validation.
